summary: Tested Setoran/Deposit P0 overhaul end-to-end with a controlled temporary TEST_ rider seeded directly in Mongo (rider_stock, 3 sales incl. split bundle, EOD) and HARD-DELETED afterwards (all collections back to baseline: 1 user, 0 deposits/sales/eod/rider_stock/menu_stock_tx, 7 notifications). Core requirements PASS: forged cash/qris/stock/price/total fields are ignored and totals come from server eod_summary (cash 36000, qris 35000, cups 7, bundle split 45000); POST /api/deposits rejects before closed EOD (400); Cash/QRIS rendered as read-only <output>; only Sisa/Wastage selects editable; Wastage>0 gets text-primary font-bold (rgb 255,106,0); Save disabled until closed EOD; PIC+Rider on same row desktop & mobile; gold orange gradient border; no horizontal overflow at 390px; Bento vertical padding halved (desktop 19.2->9.6px, mobile 10.24->5.12px) with no clipping; POS BundleDialog QtySelect options capped at min(need, remaining). Found 3 backend bugs and 2 frontend bugs (below).

critical.issue: pic_id pointing to a nonexistent user returns 500 (pic=None then pic['id'] TypeError). Should 404/400 or fall back to current user.

minor.issue: Partial write: menu_stock_tx wastage records are inserted inside the row loop BEFORE all rows are validated, so a request rejected with 400 (later row exceeds stock) still leaves wastage tx docs for earlier rows. Validate all rows first, then write.

Re-saving the same rider/date deposit (upsert) inserts duplicate wastage menu_stock_tx rows each time (3->4 on identical re-save). Delete/replace previous wastage tx for that rider+date or make idempotent.
rider_id is not validated to be role=='rider' (any user id accepted if EOD doc exists).

ui_bugs.issue: QtySelect only clamps the DISPLAYED value; parent state keeps the stale higher value. Repro: Americano stock10 sold4, set Sisa=3, Wastage=2, then Sisa=6 -> wastage select shows 0 (1 option) but calc-wastage still '2 cup', orange class stays, and Save sends wastage=2 -> backend 400 'Sisa dan wastage SI AMERICANO melebihi stok tersedia'. Fix: when remaining changes, clamp wastage in setCell (wastage=min(wastage, stock-sold-remaining)).

Race condition / no stale-response guard: selecting rider (fetch for today) then quickly changing date (fetch for 2030-01-15) - on mobile the earlier 'today' response arrived last and overwrote state: date input shows 01/15/2030 but table/EOD status show today's data ('Rider belum menutup'). Add an ignore flag/AbortController in the effect cleanup. Also no try/catch -> unhandled rejection on API error.

issues: PIC input (40px) is taller than Rider select (36px from select.field mobile rule) so the inline pair looks misaligned
Date uses native <input type=date> instead of shadcn calendar
Receipt lists bundle component menus as e.g. 'SI CREAMY LATTE x2 Rp 0' (qty includes bundle components but amount excludes) - confusing
Each QtySelect max is min(need, remaining) and is not reduced by other selections, so user can pick 6/4; Save is correctly disabled but options could be capped at need - (sum of others)

action_items: Handle unknown pic_id in save_deposit (404 or fallback to u) - currently 500
Validate all rows before inserting wastage menu_stock_tx; make wastage tx idempotent on deposit re-save
Clamp wastage state in DepositPage when Sisa changes (stale value causes wrong calc + 400 on save)
Guard DepositPage load effect against out-of-order responses and add error handling
Optional: validate rider role in save_deposit; align PIC input/Rider select heights on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: DepositIn ignores extra fields (pydantic default) - forged cash/qris/stock fields confirmed ignored; consider model_config extra='forbid' to explicitly reject as requested ('ignore or reject' - ignore satisfied)
Frontend calc 'sold' = cash+qris qty while backend uses eod_row['sold']; equal today but cash_qty/qris_qty use per-item rounding - keep both derived from the same field (sold) to avoid drift
DepositPage EMPTY/calc fine; DepositPage.jsx and server.py are large (server.py >1500 lines) - consider splitting deposits into its own router

success_rate.backend: 70% (7/10 tests; all 3 failures are secondary bugs, core server-side totals + EOD gate pass)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (all 7 requested checks pass; 2 bugs found in wastage state clamp and load race)

seed_data_creation: Temporary rider TEST_rider_<hex> / TEST_rider_ui with rider_stock, sales, eod, deposits, notifications, menu_stock_tx were seeded directly in Mongo and fully hard-deleted after tests (verified baseline counts). No Google Sheets sync configured, so nothing leaked externally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend test SEQUENTIALLY: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_deposit_eod_server_totals.py -p no:randomly -n0` (xdist/random order breaks the ordered gate->close->save flow). The fixture seeds and cleans its own TEST_ rider. For UI: `python /app/backend/tests/seed_deposit_ui.py seed` (date 2030-01-15 closed EOD), then `... clean`. Browser auth: fetch identify/login in page, set localStorage si4am_token, si4am_legal_2026-06-01=accepted, si4am_session_wib_date=<WIB today>; sessionStorage si4am_pos=1 for POS; owner POS needs clicking 'Absen' button to reveal pos-rider-select. Playbook auth checks (bcrypt/cookies/lockout) not executed this iteration (out of scope).
rca of the issue: Wastage stale state: QtySelect's safeValue = min(value, max) only affects rendering; DepositPage.setCell never re-clamps dependent wastage when remaining changes, so rows state/payload retain the old value. pic 500: save_deposit uses `await db.users.find_one(...) if body.pic_id else u` with no None check. Partial/duplicate wastage tx: insert_one is executed inside the per-row validation loop and runs on every upsert save.
